words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我来自伦敦。(Wǒ láizì Lúndūn.) — I come from London.
你是哪国人？(Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?) — What is your nationality?
我叫大卫，很高兴认识你。(Wǒ jiào Dàwèi, hěn gāoxìng rènshí nǐ.) — My name is David, nice to meet you.
李明是我的中文老师。(Lǐ Míng shì wǒ de zhōngwén lǎoshī.) — Li Ming is my Chinese teacher.
我是大学生，我学中文。(Wǒ shì dàxuéshēng, wǒ xué zhōngwén.) — I am a university student, I study Chinese.
我在一家国际公司工作。(Wǒ zài yì jiā guójì gōngsī gōngzuò.) — I work at an international company.
周末我喜欢在家听音乐。(Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuan zài jiā tīng yīnyuè.) — On weekends I like listening to music at home.
他三十多岁，是一名医生。(Tā sānshí duō suì, shì yì míng yīshēng.) — He is in his thirties and is a doctor.
你结婚了吗？— 还没有。(Nǐ jiéhūn le ma? — Hái méiyǒu.) — Are you married? — Not yet.
你为什么学中文？— 我还在想。(Nǐ wèishénme xué zhōngwén? — Wǒ hái zài xiǎng.) — Why are you learning Chinese? — I'm still thinking about it.
我们聊点别的吧，今天天气真好。(Wǒmen liáo diǎnr bié de ba, jīntiān tiānqì zhēn hǎo.) — Let's talk about something else, the weather today is really nice.

words.English Meaning: prefer not to say / rather not say
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 这个我不太想说，不好意思。(Zhège wǒ bú tài xiǎng shuō, bù hǎoyìsi.) — I'd rather not say this, sorry.
你会说什么语言？(Nǐ huì shuō shénme yǔyán?) — What languages can you speak?
我会说英语和一点中文。(Wǒ huì shuō yīngyǔ hé yìdiǎnr zhōngwén.) — I can speak English and a little Chinese.
她也会说一点日语。(Tā yě huì shuō yìdiǎnr rìyǔ.) — She can also speak a little Japanese.
我们班都在学汉语。(Wǒmen bān dōu zài xué hànyǔ.) — Our class is all studying Mandarin.
我是英国人，来自伦敦。(Wǒ shì yīngguó rén, láizì Lúndūn.) — I am British, from London.
他是加拿大人，在上海工作。(Tā shì jiānádà rén, zài Shànghǎi gōngzuò.) — He is Canadian, working in Shanghai.
她是新加坡人，英语很好。(Tā shì xīnjiāpō rén, yīngyǔ hěn hǎo.) — She is Singaporean, her English is great.
请问你多大了？(Qǐngwèn nǐ duō dà le?) — May I ask how old you are?
你的大学专业是什么？(Nǐ de dàxué zhuānyè shì shénme?) — What is your college major?
你现在读几年级？(Nǐ xiànzài dú jǐ niánjí?) — What school year are you in right now?
我和室友一起租房。(Wǒ hé shìyǒu yìqǐ zūfáng.) — I rent an apartment with my roommate.
很高兴在会上遇到同行。(Hěn gāoxìng zài huì shang yùdào tóngháng.) — Glad to meet peers in the industry at the conference.
